msg: Make sure you are quick because it will time out if you don't give an answer. I found that the big purple gnome was the most consistent one for picking out loads of mushrooms.  I found the small red one was good in the beginning but became bad - when this became bad the big brown one was good.Make sure you pay attention to how many you are getting because if one gives you zero don't pick it next time. Mainly don't get it screen out and not click!  Have your fingers ont he buttons and don't move them (when I did I timed out because i couldn't rmeember was letter it was I should click!)Good luck!
